new.name: hot-path-row-iteration
new.detail: The forcing row for step 8. skutil has three interpreter-level hot paths that iterate in Python where the data is rectangular and the work is vectorisable: `filter_collinearity` (skutil/feature_selection/select.py) drives a `while not finished` greedy drop whose body `enumerate`-scans the remaining columns each pass; `InteractionTermTransformer.transform` (skutil/preprocessing/transform.py) builds an interaction-name list by comprehension and then runs a nested `for i in range(n)` / `for j in range(i+1, n)` over every column pair; and `GainsStatisticalReport.as_data_frame` (skutil/metrics/_act.py) loops `for metric in dict_keys(self._signs)` and, inside it, a nested `for _ in range(n_iter)` / `for _fold in range(n_folds)` that accumulates the fold table one cell at a time. The AST instrument is scoped to exactly those three functions (functions=HOT_PATHS) and charges every `for` and every comprehension in them whatever its iterator -- a bare `for x in seq`, an `enumerate`/`zip`/`range`, a `.iterrows()`/`.itertuples()` -- and every `while` in them, with one deliberate exemption: filter_collinearity's single top-level `while not finished` is the greedy driver, structural control flow rather than row iteration, so a `while` that is a direct child of that function's body (no enclosing loop) is not charged, while its inner `enumerate` scan is. Every other loop form and every nested `while` counts, one per loop, so a nested pair counts twice; this closes the bypass of respelling a charged `for i in range(n)` as an equivalent `for x in seq` or a comprehension. Seven on the tree step 8 is handed (step 7's golden): one in filter_collinearity (the inner enumerate scan; its top-level while is the exempt driver), three in transform (the interaction-name comprehension and the i/j range pair) and three in as_data_frame (the metric loop and the iter/fold range pair). The golden vectorises all three -- filter_collinearity to a boolean-mask sweep over the correlation matrix, transform to `np.triu_indices` broadcast column-pair products with `np.char.add` names, as_data_frame to a `reshape(n_iter, n_folds)` fold aggregation with the two metrics unrolled -- taking the count to zero, while item 5's gates require every one of the 1236 recorded answers to land within tolerance. Entry tree 7, golden 0; a forcing row -- the step-7 floor tree fails it and only the vectorising rewrite clears it.

new.name: persistence-and-examples
new.detail: Added in review round 2 for two task-line items (migration-lines.md §28): the gate "pickles replaced by skops/ONNX with versioned schemas" and step 8's "notebooks executed as tests". The one place the repository persists a fitted model is doc/examples/pipeline/skutil grid demo.ipynb, which saves its RandomizedSearchCV with joblib.dump and reads it back with joblib.load -- a pickle, which executes code when loaded and is bound to the class layout of the versions that wrote it. Observed = the AST rule `pickle-persistence` (pickle/_pickle/joblib/cloudpickle/dill dump(s)/load(s), Pickler/Unpickler, pandas read_pickle/to_pickle and any .to_pickle(...), shelve.open, numpy.load(allow_pickle=True); resolved through the file's own imports and getattr fetches) + one for each of the save and the load the tree no longer makes through skops.io (scan.call_census), so deleting the two cells clears only half of it + one for each example notebook that does not run: the `notebooks` stage executes the code cells of the two notebooks the stack can still run (the decomposition and pipeline walkthroughs; `ml demo.ipynb` is built on the removed load_boston) as a script, unprivileged, against the installed wheel -- which is what proves the skops round trip works rather than merely being written. Measured on the entry tree (step 7's golden, round-2 oracle run, in this step's verifier image): 2 pickle-family calls (joblib.dump at the notebook's line 87, joblib.load at 91), no skops.io call, both notebooks run -> 2 + 2 + 0 = 4. The golden saves search.best_estimator_ with skops.io.dump and loads it with skops.io.load(trusted=get_untrusted_types(...)) -> 0, both notebooks running (pipeline ~80 s, decomposition ~5 s at 7 vCPU). Dumping the search object itself raises RecursionError under skops 0.13.0, which is why the run matters. Weighted 1 against hot-path-row-iteration's 3.

new.name: environment-lock
new.detail: Added in review round 2 (migration-lines.md §28 step 8: "environment lock"). The repository carries a PEP 751 lock of the environment it is built, tested and run in: `pylock.toml` at its root, lock-version 1.0, one [[packages]] entry per distribution. Observed = how many of the nineteen distributions this step's environment is built from (steps/08-performance-lock/workdir/setup.sh's pin list, verbatim: the runtime stack, the columnar engines, the notebook toolchain, skops, and the build/test tooling) the lock does not pin at exactly the installed version; names compared PEP 503-normalised. No file, a symlink, a file that is not TOML, or a lock-version other than 1.0 is a lock of nothing (19). These pins are the step's own environment definition, fixed by setup.sh, not a recording of behaviour; transitive dependencies are not asked for because their versions are resolved at install time and may differ between the agent's environment and this image. Entry tree 19 (no lock), golden 0 (written from importlib.metadata of /opt/venv). Weighted 1 against hot-path-row-iteration's 3.

carried.name: estimator-contract
carried.detail: Every estimator the package exports stores each `__init__` parameter under its own name and survives `clone()` -- `BaseEstimator.get_params` reads parameters off attributes of exactly those names, and 0.22 removed the None fallback so a missing one raises. Step 2 earned this (four of the twenty-six failed on the tree it was handed); step 8 carries it, and it is directly in the blast radius here: InteractionTermTransformer is one of the three hot paths, so its transform is being rewritten, and a vectorisation that moved a parameter into the method body or renamed an attribute would break the round-trip while clearing the row it was chasing. Both halves are checked, structural (readable under its own name) and executed (`clone` returns it), because either alone is gameable; a parameter the probe cannot construct counts as a failure, and the keys are bare class names so moving a class between modules is not a missing estimator. The tree step 8 is handed (step 7's golden) imports under this step's stack; this invariant is scored on the candidate as it is on the oracle. Measured inside this step's verifier image.

carried.name: repro-invariants
carried.detail: Importing the package does not disturb the global RNG, a seeded workload is repeatable across processes, and a seeded plot is byte-identical across processes. Steps 1 and 2 earned these; step 8 may not spend them. The seeded-workload half is a general guard on the package's sampling paths, and it is worth being precise about why step 8 does not put it at risk: none of this step's three rewrites touches an RNG. GainsStatisticalReport.as_data_frame aggregates the fold statistics already recorded on the report (self.stats and self.sample_sizes, populated during the fold fits that ran before it is ever called); it draws nothing itself, and neither the correlation-matrix sweep nor the interaction-term broadcast samples -- so a vectorised rewrite of the three paths cannot change the order or count of RNG draws. The invariant still carries because the fold-fitting code that does draw is untouched, and it is scored on the candidate as it is on the oracle to catch a rewrite that reached further than the three paths and disturbed a seeded run even while every recorded value still matched. The tree step 8 is handed (step 7's golden) imports under this step's stack; measured inside this step's verifier image.
